protocol.source: Yang, Qiao & Liu, IEEE TNNLS 2018, Section III-A (synthetic WCS)
protocol.generation: 2D coordinates iid U[0,1]; random planted L-partial permutation; matched G coordinates replaced by H plus iid N(0,sigma^2); Euclidean edge weights; a shared Erdős-Rényi topology is assigned to the planted vertex pairs and outlier-incident edges are sampled independently; independently add and remove round(0.5*sigma*edge_count) edges per graph, with every edge weighted by its endpoint Euclidean distance.
protocol.accuracy: correct planted pairs / L, percent; all methods receive identical seeded graph instances
protocol.timing: Separate from accuracy runs. One process; randomized method order per timing repetition; configured warm-ups excluded; wall-clock includes solver construction and adapter projection. BLAS/OpenMP thread count is fixed by --threads. Hardware-dependent; report medians and raw samples, not a universal speed claim.
protocol.objective: F(X)=||(X1)(X1)^T o A_G - X A_H X^T||_F^2, alpha=1; lower is better. Reported on every returned discrete exact-L assignment.
deviations: The paper does not fully specify the PRNG, perturbation rounding, topology coupling, or all solver settings; these are fixed here and exposed in this output.
A shared latent topology over planted pairs is an explicit reconstruction assumption; do not describe this as exact reproduction of the original code without author-code verification.
The base-paper methods are not all available as original executable implementations. In-repository GNCCP variants and PyGMtools/GRAMPA adapters are labelled accordingly.
Generic PyGMtools and GRAMPA scores are converted to an exact-L partial permutation using an augmented assignment problem; the adapter is timed and is not native WCS support.

This is a synthetic WCS/PIW benchmark inspired by ECCV 2022's common-input, version-pinned, objective/runtime reporting. It is not a reproduction of ECCV's computer-vision datasets or containerized solver suite.
A smoke run using --limit-settings is for code validation only and must not be reported as a full paper benchmark.

method_mapping.Fast-WCS v3: Current proposed implementation, exact-L Burkard oracle, quartic search, exchange/replacement local refinement.
method_mapping.Local 2018-style RLX1F: In-repository higher-order-gradient GNCCP with grid search and heuristic truncation; local reconstruction, not the original MATLAB code.
method_mapping.PyGMtools SM (2024 toolkit): Spectral matching implementation exposed by PyGMtools; exact-L post-projection.
method_mapping.PyGMtools RRWM (2024 toolkit): Reweighted random walks matching implementation exposed by PyGMtools; exact-L post-projection.
method_mapping.PyGMtools IPFP (2024 toolkit): Integer projected fixed point implementation exposed by PyGMtools; exact-L post-projection.
method_mapping.GRAMPA (ICML 2020): Published all-eigenpair spectral method for correlated weighted graph matching, extended to rectangular score matrix and exact-L assignment projection; eta fixed to 0.10.

base_paper_method_availability.SM: not a separately faithful run: available only as PyGMtools SM implementation
base_paper_method_availability.GA: not implemented in this workspace; must add a verified source or faithful reproduction
base_paper_method_availability.PGM: not implemented in this workspace; must add a verified source or faithful reproduction
base_paper_method_availability.EPF: not implemented in this workspace; must add a verified source or faithful reproduction
base_paper_method_availability.RLX1/RLX2: not present as original paper implementations; the local solver is an RLX1F-style reconstruction
base_paper_method_availability.RLX1F/RLX2F: only local 2018-style RLX1F reconstruction is runnable; RLX2F is unavailable
